title: gate/1 — a gated script's report
description: The JSON a gate script prints or writes: one verdict, `pass`, over named gates. A gate with no boolean `pass` is a failed gate, and a report with no boolean `pass` is a failed report. Both levels stay open to the extras producers carry (tool, clip, blender, per-gate detail); the required keys are what catch a misspelt or old-dialect verdict.

pass.description: true only when every gate ran and passed

ok.description: the old name of `pass`, still written beside it for one release; must equal `pass`

verdict.description: the ledger word: green = pass, failed = a gate failed, harness = nothing was verified

refused.description: why the input was refused; the report then fails

error.description: why the harness could not measure; the report then fails

name.description: dotted, stable across runs: deform.volume_loss_max, foot_slide_p95_m

value.description: what was measured; any JSON value, null when not measurable

limit.description: what it was held to: a number, a string such as "<= 0.03", a list, or null
